hints.title: Contiguous Group Merging
hints.text: When bit x is turned on, it merges contiguous segments of ones adjacent to its left (x - 1) and right (x + 1).

hints.title: Endpoint Segment Tracking
hints.text: Maintain an array length[i] storing the length of the segment for its endpoints. When merging, only endpoints need updating.

hints.title: Group Count State
hints.text: Track the count of active groups of length m. When count of groups of length m is positive, update latest step.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def findLatestStep(self, arr: list[int], m: int) -> int:
        n = len(arr)
        if m == n:
            return n
        length = [0] * (n + 2)
        count = [0] * (n + 1)
        ans = -1
        for step, x in enumerate(arr, 1):
            left = length[x - 1]
            right = length[x + 1]
            new_len = left + right + 1
            length[x - left] = new_len
            length[x + right] = new_len
            count[left] -= 1
            count[right] -= 1
            count[new_len] += 1
            if count[m] > 0:
                ans = step
        return ans
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the entire array for size-m groups after each step takes O(N^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Endpoint length updates take O(1) amortized time per step, totaling O(N) time and O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate updates segment boundary lengths in O(1) and dynamically tracks size-m group counts.
complexity.notes: Returns -1 if no group of size m ever existed.
